newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Trading quiet in after hours.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Trading quiet in after hours.

text.p: Traders said after-hours activity was quiet on Tuesday.
During market hours, International Business Machines Corp soared, gaining 6-3/4 to reach 153-3/4 and helping the Dow industrials jump 50 points to about 6398.
The New York Stock Exchange said its session one volume was 66,300 shares compared to 231,600 shares on Monday. Session two volume was 7,498,775 shares compared to 237,,300 shares on Monday.
The American Stock Exchange said it had no after-hours activity.
